notes.title: Minor update - forced start for lobby after 90 sec
notes.content:
I saw that some people sleep and do not start a battle. So I made a "forced start" function for the game after 90 seconds, so that other players could start playing.

Thank you for testing this game!

notes.title: Update 0.0.0.1.4.3
notes.content:
Added - now on the base of sometimes will have added bots
Added - Support for displays 5: 4 (eg 1280x1024)
Added - new setting motion blur
Added - healing from their base
Added - damage from the enemy base

Changed - Increased armor on the basis of vehicle
Changed - Removed unnecessary settings and moved on a single page
Changed - lowered the gun rotation speed of the bots
Changed - slightly increased base area for the buildings on the base border

Fixed - some players could not see the interface in battle
Fixed - sometimes game didnt work after language selection
Fixed - sometimes wouldn't give points for the capture of the train
Fixed - sometimes wouldn't view the thruster engines of buggy
Fixed - rotated the tower at tramplins
Fixed - sometimes incorrectly apply damage/healing

Thank you for finded bugs, tester!
Impulse of War coming soon 24 of february.
